title: Delete These 3 npm Packages
sub: The platform already does it. Zero installs.
intro: You don't need these 3 npm packages anymore.

tricks.title: uuid → randomUUID()
tricks.note: Native v4 UUIDs in browsers (HTTPS) and Node 19+.

tricks.title: qs → URLSearchParams
tricks.note: Build query strings from an object. Built in everywhere.

caption:
You don't need these 3 npm packages anymore.

uuid → crypto.randomUUID()
moment's fromNow() → Intl.RelativeTimeFormat
qs → URLSearchParams

Fewer dependencies, smaller bundles, nothing to update.

Which one is still in your package.json?

Send this to a teammate who still installs uuid.
Save this for later.
alt: Five dark code-editor slides showing native replacements for three npm packages: crypto.randomUUID for uuid, Intl.RelativeTimeFormat for moment, and URLSearchParams for qs.
